services.name: Kelowna Flyboarding
services.desc: Looking to try something completely different on the water? Our Osoyoos flyboarding experience lets you rise above the lake using a powerful jet-propelled board connected to a personal watercraft. With warm water, open space, and fewer crowds, Osoyoos Lake is the perfect place to learn, practice, and actually enjoy the experience without feeling rushed. Take to the sky with a private flight session starting with expert instruction from our experienced staff. Flyboarding uses high-pressure water jets to lift you above the surface, giving you the ability to hover, glide, and move through the air. services.name: Float Charter
services.desc: Departure Locations: Downtown Kelowna Dock, Kelowna International Airport (CYLW), or Osoyoos Dock (tour dependent) Available For: Couples, families, business travel, special occasions, and sightseeing Take your Okanagan adventure to new heights with a breathtaking floatplane tour or private air charter. Whether you're looking for a scenic sightseeing flight over Osoyoos Lake or a unique way to travel between Kelowna and Osoyoos, there's simply no better view of the South Okanagan. In partnership with Air Hart Aviation, Lakefront Sports offers unforgettable aviation experiences that showcase the region's lakes, vineyards, mountains, and desert landscapes from an entirely new perspective.

blurb: Lakefront Sports Centre offers a variety of water sport rentals including cruisers, ski boats, wake boats, pontoon boats, jet skis, paddleboards, kayaks, and water bikes. They also provide bike rentals including eBikes and mountain bikes, as well as guided tours such as KVR bike tours and boat charters. Locations are in downtown Kelowna and Osoyoos, serving the Okanagan region.
